title: Hearthlight Bomb
summary: Throw a Hearthlight Bomb to light a 30 ft radius.

fields.Throw: Action. Consume one bomb to toss it up to 60 ft. Creates a Dancing Lights area for 10 turns.
fields.Crafting: Combine Essence of Nightlight with any Suspension.
fields.Base value: 13 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
